messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Bazaar jaa rahe ho? List bhejo: doodh, anday, dhania, aur 1 kg tamatar.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Ji ammi kuch aur? Chawal khatam ho gaye thay kal.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Haan haan 5 kg basmati bhi le aao, aur sabzi mandi se lena sasta parega.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Theek hai ammi, 30 minute mein pohanch jaunga.
